1386	func parseMatcherDefinitions(d *caddyfile.Dispenser, matchers map[string]caddy.ModuleMap) error {
1387		d.Next() // advance to the first token
1388	
1389		// this is the "name" for "named matchers"
1390		definitionName := d.Val()
1391	
1392		if _, ok := matchers[definitionName]; ok {
1393			return fmt.Errorf("matcher is defined more than once: %s", definitionName)
1394		}
1395		matchers[definitionName] = make(caddy.ModuleMap)
1396	
1397		// given a matcher name and the tokens following it, parse
1398		// the tokens as a matcher module and record it
1399		makeMatcher := func(matcherName string, tokens []caddyfile.Token) error {
1400			// create a new dispenser from the tokens
1401			dispenser := caddyfile.NewDispenser(tokens)
1402	
1403			// set the matcher name (without @) in the dispenser context so
1404			// that matcher modules can access it to use it as their name
1405			// (e.g. regexp matchers which use the name for capture groups)
1406			dispenser.SetContext(caddyfile.MatcherNameCtxKey, definitionName[1:])
